performance.methodology: Lighthouse mobile simulated throttling, three sequential production runs after deployment; medians include all samples.
performance.variance: Run 2 LCP was 4.696 s because the LCP element render delay increased to 2.094 s. Its TBT remained 47.5 ms and the catalogue prefetch regression did not recur.

rootCause.primary: Next.js Link prefetch from catalogue links in the global shell and homepage fetched /catalogue/index.txt?_rsc=... and catalogue JavaScript before user intent.
changes: Disabled catalogue prefetch in desktop navigation, mobile navigation, homepage CTA and footer.
Kept catalogue data route-scoped and out of homepage/global layout payloads.
Added a browser regression test that rejects catalogue payload requests before user intent.
Added deterministic fail-closed shared and route JavaScript budgets.
rootCause.analytics: One deferred GA script, one js initialization and one config call were observed. No duplicate initialization, client reinjection, route-event loop or console error was observed.

comparison.conclusion: Bundle growth was negligible; the regression was runtime prefetch and processing cost.

largestDeferredOrPrevented: Catalogue-related shared chunk execution before intent

buildScale.assessment: The noindex catalogue remains a material 1.88 GiB deployment cost. No bulk deletion was justified because Phase 6 established a runtime prefetch cause independently of route count.

google.notes: Public observation only; authenticated confirmation unavailable.

bing.notes: NOT_OBSERVED is not equivalent to NOT_INDEXED.

crawlerLogs.notes: The available Vercel log query returned zero rows; no crawler identity claim was made.

catalogueQuality.notes: The prompt count was stale. Every actual indexable catalogue URL passed the page-main-scoped quality gate with identifying data, metadata, self-canonical, visual, provenance, category context, commercial utility and structured data.

entityAuthority.maps: Two public Google Maps locations exist; ownership and full fields remain unverified.
entityAuthority.zalo: Phone matches the first-party phone; full business profile identity is unverified.
entityAuthority.manufacturerSupplierCorroboration: No explicit public authorized-dealer, reseller or partner relationship was found; manufacturer sources are used only as technical provenance.

strongestInformationAsset.name: Material Reference Center and six-material comparison matrix
changes: Added stable row anchors for direct citations.
Added direct row-level links to source records.
Included source records in the downloadable JSON.
Kept CSV and JSON machine-readable formats and explicit null/verification caveats.
strongestInformationAsset.informationGain: A reader or retrieval system can cite a specific material row, inspect its exact evidence, and download the same source-backed structure without inferring unsupported values.

authorityDiagnosis: Technical crawlability, schema, internal linking and content coverage are healthy, while public search observation remains 0/40 and authenticated indexation data is unavailable. The remaining bottleneck is external discovery/entity corroboration and search-engine processing time, not another large on-site page expansion.

defaultE2e.notes: Two 30-second environment timeouts passed individually with a 90-second timeout; main CI passed the full E2E suite.

Bing Webmaster and Bing Places require an authenticated owner session; no in-app browser session was available.
Maps ownership/profile fields, official Facebook identity, full Zalo identity and supplier/dealer relationships remain unverified.
